chunks: There was a man among the close companions of Rūzḥusnā, and another was with him. He said to him, “There he is: he collects the funds, and he has agents,” and they named all the agents in the surrounding regions. This was conveyed to ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Sulaymān, the vizier, so the vizier intended to arrest them. Then the ruler said, “Find where this man is, for this is a grave matter.”

So ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Sulaymān said, “Let us arrest the agents.” But the ruler said, “No. Rather, send to them some people unknown to them with funds, and whoever among them receives anything, he should be arrested.”

He said: Then an order was issued to all the agents that they should not take anything from anyone, that they should refrain from doing so, and that they should feign ignorance of the matter. Then a man infiltrated to Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, whom he did not know, and met him privately. He said, “I have some money that I want to deliver.” Muḥammad said to him, “You are mistaken; I do not know anything about this.” He continued trying gently with him while Muḥammad kept feigning ignorance toward him. Spies were sent out, and all the agents refrained because of what had already been communicated to them.

key_terms.الْأَمْوَالَ: funds or wealth being collected and transferred
key_terms.الْجَوَاسِيسَ: spies sent to monitor and entrap
key_terms.الْقَبْضِ: arrest or seizure by the authorities
key_terms.الْوَزِيرِ: the vizier, a high-ranking government official
key_terms.وُكَلَاءُ: agents or representatives acting on behalf of another
key_terms.يَتَجَاهَلُوا: to feign ignorance and avoid disclosure

ai.seo_question: How did the Imam’s agents avoid detection when the authorities tried to trap them with money?
ai.summary: This report describes a political effort to uncover and arrest the Imam’s financial agents by means of infiltration and surveillance. It also shows how advance warning led the agents to refuse receiving funds and to conceal their roles, thereby preventing the authorities from apprehending them.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Al Hassan Al Alawy said,

‘There was a man from the informants of Rouz Hasany, and another one was with him, and he said to him, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> is that (Imam<sup>asws</sup>). The wealth comes to him<sup>asws</sup>, and for him<sup>asws</sup> are agents’, and he named the entirety of the agents in the surrounding areas, and that ended up to Ubeydullah Bin Suleyman, the Vizier. So the Vizier thought of capturing them, but the Sultan said, ‘Seek where this man<sup>asws</sup> is, for this is a serious matter’.

So Ubeydullah Bin Suleyman said, ‘We should capture the agents’, but the Sultan said, ‘No, but send a group of people with some wealth to them whom they do not recognise, and the one from them who takes possession of anything, capture him’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So there came out (a letter) to the entirety of the agents that they should not be taking anything from anyone, and that they should be preventing from that and be ignorant of the matter. So a man came over to Muhammad Bin Ahmad whom he did not recognise, and isolated with him, then said to him, ‘There is some wealth with me I am intending to deliver to him<sup>asws</sup>’. So Muhammad said to him, ‘You are mistaken. I do not know anything from this’. But he did not cease to be nice to him, and Muhammad kept on being ignorant over it, and they sent spies across and the agents, all of them refused (to take anything) due to what (message) had proceeded to them’.
en.sarwar: 30. Al-Husayn ibn al-Hassan al-‘Alawi has said the following.

“A man who was an informer for Ruz Hassani with another man with him once said to Ruz, “This man (al-Mahdi (a.s.) is out there. Money is collected for him. He has representatives in many places. They mentioned his representatives by their names in different areas. This news reached ‘Ubaydallah ibn Sulayman, the vizier. The Vizier decided to arrest these representatives. The Sultan said, “Find out. Where is this man? This is a serious matter.”

‘Ubaydallah ibn Sulayman then said, “We will arrest the representatives, the agent.” The Sultan said, “No, you must send your undercover agents who would pose to them as devotees ready to pay their dues to their Imam. If they accepted the funds then arrest them.”

The narrator has said that message came out from the holy location (office of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.) to inform all the representatives not to accept any dues from anyone, deny knowing anything about the Imam (a.s.) and say that they have no information. A man who was an undercover agent came to Muhammad ibn Ahmad whom he did not know. The undercover agent spoke to him privately and said, “I have certain funds with me and I want it to be delivered to the holy location (office of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.).” Muhammad said to him, “You have made a mistake. I do not know anything about it. He would insist and try to show kindness and Muhammad would deny having any knowledge of it. The spies spread to all places but the representatives refuse to accept any funds because of the message that was dilivered to them before hand.”
